Tom.</VOLUME> <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT> <YEAR>1741</YEAR>; davon die 3. ersten Tom. dato schon zu beziehen sind; das gantze Werck kostet samt der Fracht <PRICE>fl. 24</PRICE></BIBL>. <BIBL><TITLE>Dictionaire Oeconomique, continant les moyens d'Augmenter son dien & de conserver sa sante</TITLE>, par <AUTHOR>Mister Noel Chomel</AUTHOR>, Augmente dun Nouveau Supplement de deur Volumes, par <AUTHOR>F. Marset, Doct. en Medecines</AUTHOR>. <FORMAT>2vec fig.</FORMAT> <VOLUME>4. Tom.</VOLUME> <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT> <YEAR>1741</YEAR>; davon der erste Tomus dato bey ihnen zu beziehen ist; diß gantze Werck kostet samt der Fracht <PRICE>fl. 18</PRICE></BIBL>. So dann sind bey ihnen auch genugsam annoch zu haben: <BIBL><TITLE>Dictionaire Historique & Critique de Mr. Bayle</TITLE> <VOLUME>4. Tom.</VOLUME> <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT> <PLACE>Amsterd.</PLACE> <YEAR>1740</YEAR>. à <PRICE>L. 27</PRICE></BIBL>. <BIBL><TITLE>Corpus Juris Civilis Romani, cum Notis Gotofrest</TITLE> <VOLUME>2. 2. '√º' (corrupted encoding) → 'ü' in 'Bücher' (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
3. '√ª' (corrupted encoding) → 'u' in 'Subscriptiones' (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
4. '√©' (corrupted encoding) → 'é' in 'appellé' (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
5. '&' → '&' in three TITLE elements (XML escaping for ampersands, applied to all three occurrences in TITLE tags).
6. '<FORMAT>2vec fig.</FORMAT>' misplaced period and tag moved to correct position after closing AUTHOR tag (minor structural fix).
7. '√ü' (corrupted encoding) → 'ß' in 'diß' (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
8. All occurrences of '<PRIZE>' → '<PRICE>' for consistency and correctness (PRIZE is not a valid tag; PRICE is used elsewhere in the document — fixed in BIBL 1, 2, 3, and 5).
9. '√†' (corrupted encoding) → 'à' (the price-introducing preposition) in three BIBL entries (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
10. Mismatched closing tag '</PRICE>' on the last BIBL (was '</PRICE>' closing a '<PRIZE>' open tag) — corrected by standardising to '<PRICE>...</PRICE>'.
11. '√≤' (corrupted encoding) → '°' in FORMAT '4°.' (OCR/encoding artifact fixed).
12. Stray '-' after TITLE in BIBL 3 removed (typographic artifact, not part of the title structure).
